items.docs: Get the daily Lichess puzzle in JSON format.

info.name: Get a puzzle by its ID

items.docs: Get a single Lichess puzzle in JSON format.

params.name: angle
params.description:
The theme or opening to filter puzzles with.

Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).

params.name: difficulty
params.description: The desired puzzle difficulty, relative to the authenticated user puzzle rating, or 1500 if anonymous.

params.name: color
params.description: The color to play. Better left empty to automatically get 50% white.

items.docs:
Get a random Lichess puzzle in JSON format.

If authenticated, only returns puzzles that the user has never seen before.

**DO NOT** use this endpoint to enumerate puzzles for mass download. Instead, download the [full public puzzle database](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles).

params.name: angle
params.description:
The theme or opening to filter puzzles with. Recommended: `mix`.

Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).

params.name: difficulty
params.description: The desired puzzle difficulty, relative to the authenticated user puzzle rating, or 1500 if anonymous.

params.name: nb
params.description: How many puzzles to fetch. Just set it to `1` if you only need one puzzle.

params.name: color
params.description:
The color to play. Better left empty to automatically get 50% white.
Currently only works when `nb=1`.

items.docs:
Get a batch of random Lichess puzzles in JSON format.

If authenticated, only returns puzzles that the user has never seen before.

**DO NOT** use this endpoint to enumerate puzzles for mass download. Instead, download the [full public puzzle database](https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles).

params.name: angle
params.description:
The theme or opening of the solved puzzles.

Available themes are listed in [the lichess source code](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/blob/master/translation/source/puzzleTheme.xml) and [the lichess training themes hyperlinks](https://lichess.org/training/themes).

params.name: nb
params.description:
When > 0, the response includes a new puzzle batch with that many puzzles.

This is equivalent to calling [/api/puzzle/batch/{angle}](#tag/puzzles/GET/api/puzzle/batch/{angle}),
and can sometimes save a request.

items.docs: Set puzzles as solved and update ratings.

params.name: max
params.description: How many entries to download. Leave empty to download all activity.

params.name: before
params.description: Download entries before this timestamp. Defaults to now. Use `before` and `max` for pagination.

params.name: since
params.description: Download entries since this timestamp. Defaults to account creation date.

items.docs:
Download your puzzle activity in [ndjson](#description/streaming-with-nd-json) format.
Puzzle activity is sorted by reverse chronological order (most recent first)
We recommend streaming the response, for it can be very long.

params.name: days
params.description: How many days to look back when aggregating puzzle results. 30 is sensible.

params.name: theme
params.description: The theme or opening to filter puzzles with.

params.description: How many days to look back when aggregating puzzle results. 30 is sensible.

items.docs:
Download your [puzzle dashboard](https://lichess.org/training/dashboard/30/dashboard) as JSON.
Also includes all puzzle themes played, with aggregated results.
Allows re-creating the [improvement/strengths](https://lichess.org/training/dashboard/30/improvementAreas) interfaces.

info.name: Get the storm dashboard of a player

params.name: days
params.description: How many days of history to return

items.docs:
Download the [storm dashboard](https://lichess.org/storm/dashboard/mrbasso) of any player as JSON.
Contains the aggregated highscores, and the history of storm runs aggregated by days.
Use `?days=0` if you only care about the highscores.

info.name: Create and join a puzzle race

items.docs:
Create a new private [puzzle race](https://lichess.org/racer).
The Lichess user who creates the race must join the race page,
and manually start the race when enough players have joined.
- <https://lichess.org/racer>

Get the results of a [puzzle race](https://lichess.org/racer).
Returns information about players, puzzles, and the current status of the race.
- <https://lichess.org/racer>

Note that Lichess puzzle races are not persisted, and are only available
for 30 minutes. After that delay, they are permanently deleted.
